scripts.name: audit-catalogue.py
scripts.source:
"""Read-only batch163 catalogue/placement audit, adapted from batch162.

--catalogue-root permits scratch preview texts. --preview explicitly permits
WRITE163SHA; final audits require the actual reconciliation commit. No supplied
verifier, proof compiler, version query, manifest interpretation or build runs.
"""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
import re
import subprocess
import zipfile

REPORTS = Path('SetTheory/Cardinals/docs/reports')
HOST = REPORTS / 'set-theory/zfc-closure-kernels'


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--catalogue-root', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--write-sha', default='WRITE163SHA')
    parser.add_argument('--preview', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert __debug__, 'Keep assertions enabled.'
    repo = args.repo.resolve()
    catalogue = args.catalogue_root.resolve() if args.catalogue_root else repo
    assert not args.output.resolve().is_relative_to(repo), 'Evidence output must be external.'
    assert not args.output.exists(), 'Do not overwrite a previous audit.'
    git = lambda *command: subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), *command])

    def authored(relative):
        path = catalogue / relative
        return path if path.exists() else repo / relative

    tex = authored(REPORTS / 'manifest.tex').read_text()

    def escaped(i):
        n, i = 0, i - 1
        while i >= 0 and tex[i] == '\\':
            n, i = n + 1, i - 1
        return n % 2 == 1

    def group(pos):
        while tex[pos].isspace():
            pos += 1
        assert tex[pos] == '{'
        start, depth, pos = pos + 1, 1, pos + 1
        while depth:
            if tex[pos] in '{}' and not escaped(pos):
                depth += 1 if tex[pos] == '{' else -1
            pos += 1
        return tex[start:pos - 1], pos

    entries = []
    for match in re.finditer(r'^\\entry\s*(?=\{)', tex, re.M):
        pos, entry = match.end(), []
        for _ in range(5):
            value, pos = group(pos)
            entry.append(value)
        entry[1] = entry[1].replace('\\', '')
        entry[2] = entry[2].replace('\\', '')
        entries.append(entry)
    assert len(entries) == 290
    paths = [x[1] for x in entries]
    assert len(set(paths)) == 290
    assert all((repo / REPORTS / x[1] / x[2]).is_file() for x in entries)
    categories = Counter(x.split('/')[0] for x in paths)
    readme = authored(REPORTS / 'README.md').read_text()
    counts = {m.group(1): int(m.group(2)) for m in re.finditer(r'^\| \[`([^`]+)/`\].*\| (\d+) \|$', readme, re.M)}
    assert dict(categories) == counts and sum(counts.values()) == 290
    tracked = git('ls-files', '-z', '--', str(REPORTS)).decode().split('\0')
    root = repo / REPORTS
    artifacts = {(repo / x).parent for x in tracked if x and Path(x).suffix in ('.tex', '.pdf')
                 and len((repo / x).relative_to(root).parts) > 1
                 and (repo / x).relative_to(root).parts[0] in categories}
    minimal = {x for x in artifacts if not any(parent in artifacts for parent in x.parents if parent != root)}
    normalized = {x.parent if x.name in ('article', 'figures') and (x.parent / 'README.md').is_file() else x for x in minimal}
    assert {str(x.relative_to(root)) for x in normalized} == set(paths)

    incoming = authored(Path('docs/incoming/README.md')).read_text()
    rows = re.findall(r'^\| (\d+) \|', incoming, re.M)
    assert len(rows) == len(set(rows)) and rows[-1] == '163'
    assert 'Sixty-seven manuscripts' in tex
    assert 'sixty-seven manuscripts' in authored(HOST / 'README.md').read_text()
    assert all('47507759e7' in value for value in (tex, readme, incoming))
    if not args.preview:
        assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{10,40}', args.write_sha)
        assert all('WRITE163SHA' not in value and args.write_sha in value for value in (tex, readme, incoming))
        git('cat-file', '-e', args.write_sha + '^{commit}')
    else:
        assert args.write_sha == 'WRITE163SHA' or re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{10,40}', args.write_sha)

    host = repo / HOST
    prefixes = {int(m.group(1)) for path in host.rglob('*') if path.is_file() and (m := re.match(r'^(\d{2})-', path.name))}
    assert set(range(1, 68)).issubset(prefixes)
    mapping = json.loads((host / 'data/intake-163-placement.json').read_text())
    assert mapping['batch'] == 163
    assert len(mapping['placements']) == 1190 and len(mapping['archive_only']) == 70
    assert {x['local_source'] for x in mapping['manuscripts']} == {64, 65, 66, 67}
    payloads = {}
    for package in mapping['manuscripts']:
        assert not (repo / package['archive']).exists()
        raw = git('show', package['arrival'] + ':' + package['archive'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == package['archive_sha256']
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
            payloads[package['local_source']] = {item['delivered']: archive.read(package['wrapper'] + '/' + item['delivered']) for item in package['files']}
    assert sum(map(len, payloads.values())) == 1260
    for placement in mapping['placements']:
        assert (repo / placement['target']).read_bytes() == payloads[placement['local_source']][placement['delivered']]
    for queued in ['zfc-sub246-research-20261018.zip', 'zfc-below246-research-20261018 (3).zip']:
        assert (repo / 'docs/incoming' / queued).is_file()
        assert all(Path(x['archive']).name != queued for x in mapping['manuscripts'])
    for name in ['intake-163.md', 'intake-163-reproduction.md']:
        text = (host / name).read_text()
        assert 'PENDING' not in text
        for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
            assert ' ' not in link and (host / link).exists(), (name, link)
    assert (host / 'article.tex').read_bytes() == git('show', '47507759e7:' + str(HOST / 'article.tex'))
    recovery = json.loads((host / 'data/intake-163-recovery.json').read_text())
    assert recovery['status'] == 'RECOVERED_ONLY'
    assert sum(x['recovered_files'] for x in recovery['packages']) == 1260
    assert sum(x['placed_byte_comparisons'] for x in recovery['packages']) == 1190
    successful, timeouts = 0, 0
    for n, expected in [(64, 10), (65, 5), (66, 8), (67, 8)]:
        run = json.loads((host / f'data/intake-163-source{n}-replay.json').read_text())
        assert len(run['commands']) == expected
        assert run['status'] == ('FAIL' if n == 66 else 'PASS')
        for command in run['commands']:
            successful += command['returncode'] == 0
            timeouts += command['returncode'] == 124
    assert (successful, timeouts) == (30, 1)
    record = dict(status='PREVIEW_PASS' if args.preview else 'PASS', batch=163,
                  placement='47507759e7', write=args.write_sha,
                  collection_reports=290, all_catalogued_roots_match=True,
                  categories=dict(categories), host_sources=67,
                  placed=1190, archive_only=70, recovered=1260,
                  four_archives_retired_and_recoverable=True,
                  later_arrivals_kept_queued=True, base_article_unchanged=True,
                  successful_jobs=30, timeout_jobs=1, proof_compiler_calls=0,
                  pdf_build_or_visual_review_claimed=False,
                  scope='Catalogue structure, exact original/placed bytes, links and result scopes; no supplied verifier replay or delivery-manifest interpretation.')
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

scripts.name: build-catalogue.py
scripts.source:
"""Build/inspect only the batch163 collection MANIFEST in new external scratch.

Adapted from batch162. Source preparation does not run this script. Three TeX
passes, PDF metadata/font checks and page rendering are separate from actual
visual review; no delivered article or proof-assistant compiler is invoked.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--catalogue-root', type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--allow-preview', action='store_true')
    a = p.parse_args()
    repo = a.repo.resolve()
    catalogue = a.catalogue_root.resolve() if a.catalogue_root else repo
    work = a.output.resolve()
    if work.is_relative_to(repo) or work.exists():
        p.error('Use a new external output directory.')
    source = catalogue / 'SetTheory/Cardinals/docs/reports/manifest.tex'
    content = source.read_text()
    preview = 'WRITE163SHA' in content
    if preview and not a.allow_preview:
        p.error('Replace WRITE163SHA before final build, or explicitly allow a preview.')
    assert 'Batch~163' in content and 'Sixty-seven manuscripts' in content
    work.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, work / 'manifest.tex')
    sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    commands = []
    for i in range(1, 4):
        print(f'MANIFEST TeX pass {i}/3', flush=True)
        cmd = ['pdflatex', '-interaction=nonstopmode', '-halt-on-error', 'manifest.tex']
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        log = work / f'pass{i}.txt'
        log.write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr)
        commands.append(dict(pass_number=i, command=cmd, returncode=result.returncode, log_sha256=sha(log)))
        assert result.returncode == 0, (work, result.stdout[-3000:])
    log = (work / 'manifest.log').read_text()
    bad = [line for line in log.splitlines() if re.search(r'(^!|LaTeX Warning|Package .* Warning|Overfull|Underfull|undefined|multiply defined|duplicate.*destination)', line)]
    assert not bad, bad
    info = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', str(work / 'manifest.pdf')], text=True, timeout=30)
    fonts = subprocess.check_output(['pdffonts', str(work / 'manifest.pdf')], text=True, timeout=30)
    text = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-layout', str(work / 'manifest.pdf'), '-'], text=True, timeout=30)
    (work / 'pdfinfo.txt').write_text(info)
    (work / 'pdffonts.txt').write_text(fonts)
    (work / 'manifest.txt').write_text(text)
    pages = int(re.search(r'Pages:\s+(\d+)', info).group(1))
    font_rows = [re.search(r'\s+(yes|no)\s+(yes|no)\s+(yes|no)\s+\d+\s+\d+\s*$', row) for row in fonts.splitlines()[2:]]
    assert font_rows and all(row is not None and row.group(1) == 'yes' for row in font_rows)
    normalized = {i: ' '.join(page.split()) for i, page in enumerate(text.split('\f'), 1) if i <= pages}
    changed = {i for i, page in normalized.items() if any(marker in page for marker in ['Batch 163', 'batch 163', 'Sixty-seven', 'sixty-seven'])}
    entry_starts = [i for i, page in normalized.items() if i >= 4 and 'ZFC closure kernels and small inconsistency-search machines' in page]
    assert entry_starts, 'Could not locate the actual extended host entry in extracted PDF text.'
    entry_start = min(entry_starts)
    # This host is the final catalogue entry, verified from the source layout.
    assert content.rfind(r'\entry{') == content.index(r'\entry{ZFC closure kernels and small inconsistency-search machines}')
    rendered = sorted({1, 2, *changed, *range(entry_start, pages + 1)})
    for page in rendered:
        print(f'Render MANIFEST page {page}/{pages}', flush=True)
        subprocess.run(['pdftoppm', '-f', str(page), '-singlefile', '-scale-to', '1300', '-png', str(work / 'manifest.pdf'), str(work / f'page-{page}')], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    record = dict(status='BUILT_VISUAL_REVIEW_PENDING', batch=163,
                  scratch=str(work), source=str(source), source_sha256=sha(source),
                  built_source_sha256=sha(work / 'manifest.tex'), pdf_sha256=sha(work / 'manifest.pdf'),
                  preview_with_write_placeholder=preview, commands=commands,
                  pages=pages, font_records=len(font_rows), all_fonts_embedded=True,
                  final_warnings_or_boxes=bad, changed_pages_detected=sorted(changed),
                  complete_host_entry_first_page=entry_start, rendered_pages=rendered,
                  visual_review_pending=True, proof_compiler_calls=0,
                  scope='Scratch collection MANIFEST only; no delivered article/PDF edits or proof build. Do not publish a preview PDF or claim visual QA before actually viewing rendered pages.')
    (work / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
